dimensions.assessment: Affects individual veterans pursuing specific flight training or contracted education programs under the VA Post-9/11 GI Bill.
dimensions.evidence: the maximum amount payable under this chapter to an individual, over the lifetime of the individual, for tuition and fees for the pursuit of a covered program of education... is-- (A) ... $119,684

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a direct financial limit on education benefits available to affected veterans.
dimensions.evidence: the maximum amount payable under this chapter to an individual, over the lifetime of the individual... is $119,684

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a statutory maximum cap on payable educational assistance, potentially altering federal outlays for these specific programs.
dimensions.evidence: the maximum amount payable under this chapter to an individual... is... $119,684

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code by adding statutory limitations on specific educational assistance categories.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to provide for a limitation on the amount of entitlement to educational assistance payable for flight training

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to academic years starting on or after August 1, 2026, with annual inflationary adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to academic years that begin on or after August 1, 2026.
